question: Where does the East Coast of India lie?

options.text: Between Gulf of Cambay and Cape Comorin
Between Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The East Coast of India lies between the Eastern Ghats mountain range and the Bay of Bengal.**
 
• **The Eastern Ghats, also known as the Mahendra Range**, is a discontinuous mountain range that runs parallel to the **East Coast of India**.
 
• It stretches along the states of** Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **The East Coast plains, **which lie between the** Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal, **are relatively flat and fertile, making them suitable for agriculture.
 
• This region is home to several major cities and important ports along the coast.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Between the Gulf of Cambay and Cape Comorin lies the western coast of India, also known as the West Coast of India.**

 
 
• The West Coast of India is situated along the** Arabian Sea and extends from the Gulf of Cambay (also known as the Gulf of Khambhat) in the north to Cape Comorin (also known as Kanyakumari) in the south.**
 
• This coastal stretch includes the states of **Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, and Kerala.**
 
• **The West Coast of India** is known for its** beautiful beaches, diverse culture, and important port cities such as Mumbai, Mangalore, Kochi, and Thiruvananthapuram.**
 
 
 
• **Between Maharashtra and Kerala lies the state of Karnataka.**
 
 
• Karnataka is located on the southwestern part of India and shares its borders with **Maharashtra to the north and Kerala to the south.**
 
• The state capital of Karnataka is Bengaluru (Bangalore), which is known as the **technology hub of India.**
 
• Karnataka is known for its** rich cultural heritage, historical sites, and natural beauty**.
 
• It is also home to several important cities and tourist destinations, including **Mysore, Hampi, Mangalore, and Coorg.**
 
 
 
• **​Between Diu and Kerala lies the state of Gujarat and the Union Territory of Daman and Diu.**
 
 
• **Diu** is a small island and town located off the southern coast of **Gujarat, while Kerala is situated on the southwestern tip of India.**
 
• **To travel from Diu to Kerala, **one would need to traverse the state of **Gujarat, pass through Maharashtra, and then enter Kerala.**
 
• The journey would involve traveling along the western coast of India.
